title: Gibson Assembly in V. natriegens
author: Daniel Marchal
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.uvdew26

steps.title: Set up Gibson reaction
steps.instruction: Combine vector, insert, water, and master mix on ice (0 °C) to assemble the Gibson assembly mixture.

substeps.instruction: Add nuclease‑free water to bring the total volume to 5 µl (0 °C).
Add 5 µl Gibson Assembly Master Mix 2X (0 °C).

steps.title: Incubate assembly
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction at 50 °C for 60 minutes.

steps.title: Store reaction
steps.instruction: Keep the assembled samples on ice or store at –20 °C until transformation.

steps.title: Transform V. natriegens
steps.instruction: Introduce 2–5 µl of the Gibson reaction into competent V. natriegens cells.
